text.p: Here are the main headlines from Lithuania's M-1 Plus radio station's noon news report on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Statistics department head Petras Adlys said Lithuania's rate of inflation in 1996 was 13.1 percent and not 24.6 percent as stated in the EU Commission report, which was the rate of annual average price changes.
- Prices paid for electricity may rise by 10 percent.

- The Russian foreign ministry considers the sentencing of Valerii Ivanov, a Russian citizen, as a political move. Ivanov was convicted of slander for his remarks about victims of the January 13, 1991 Soviet crackdown.
- A Lithuanian MI-8 military helicopter heading to Iceland for training exercises was forced to land in Norway due to bad weather.
